reason: Conversation 1 correctly and honestly recognises the dehumidifier is outside its supported appliance families and declines to diagnose it, which matches the expected out-of-scope handling; it is terse and misses the chance to point to Meaco support or note the common cold-room/target-humidity explanation, but it does no harm.
